look.why: A crisp pond-water sky blue that sets off its glossy chestnut fur, orange incisors and broad scaly paddle tail.

size.measure: total length, 0.9–1.2 m including flat tail

habitat.text: Freshwater streams, rivers, ponds, marshes and wooded lakes across North America.

diet.text: Inner bark and twigs of aspen, willow, birch and cottonwood, plus water lilies and pond plants.

facts.text: Nature's master ecosystem engineer—it builds dams of logs and mud that create thriving wetland habitats for hundreds of species.
Its front teeth are bright orange because their enamel is reinforced with iron, making them self-sharpening.
